name: Fischl
title: Prinzessin der Verurteilung!
description: A mysterious girl who calls herself "Prinzessin der Verurteilung" and travels with a night raven named Oz.

cv.japanese: 内田真礼 & 増谷康紀

skills.name: Bolts of Downfall
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, the dark lightning spirits of Immernachtreich shall heed the call of their Prinzessin and indwell the enchanted arrowhead. When fully indwelt, the Rachsüchtig Blitz shall deal immense Electro DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Nightrider
skills.description:
Summons Oz. The night raven forged of darkness and lightning descends upon the land, dealing Electro DMG in a small AoE.
For the ability's duration, Oz will continuously attack nearby opponents with Freikugel.

Hold to adjust the location Oz will be summoned to.
Press again any time during the ability's duration to once again summon him to Fischl's side.
skills.info:
"My time is most precious, and I shall not waste it on the likes of you... Go, Oz, fall upon them, and bring down upon them your Rachsüchtig Blitz, that which tears open the long night."
—Flowers for Princess Fischl (IV): Farewell Frau Welt

skills.name: Midnight Phantasmagoria
skills.description:
Summons Oz to spread his twin wings of twilight and defend Fischl.
Has the following properties during the ability's duration:
·Fischl takes on Oz's form, greatly increasing her Movement Speed.
·Strikes nearby opponents with lightning, dealing Electro DMG to opponents she comes into contact with. Each opponent can only be struck once.
·Once this ability's effects end, Oz will remain on the battlefield and attack his Prinzessin's foes. If Oz is already on the field, then this will reset the duration of his presence.
skills.info:
"...In the hordes of beasts that follow the cursed blood, only Prince Nachtraben, who bore witness to the extinction of a thousand worlds, knows her true greatness. Thus the night wings he spreads are his eternal promise to protect Her Royal Highness."
—Flowers for Princess Fischl (I): End Time Zersetzung

passives.name: Stellar Predator
passives.description: When Fischl hits Oz with a fully-charged Aimed Shot, Oz brings down Thundering Retribution, dealing AoE Electro DMG equal to 152.7% of the arrow's DMG.

passives.name: Undone Be Thy Sinful Hex
passives.description: If your current active character triggers an Electro-related Elemental Reaction when Oz is on the field, the opponent shall be stricken with Thundering Retribution that deals Electro DMG equal to 80% of Fischl's ATK.

passives.name: Mein Hausgarten
passives.description: When dispatched on an expedition in Mondstadt, time consumed is reduced by 25%.

constellations.name: Gaze of the Deep
constellations.description: Even when Oz is not present in combat, he can still watch over Fischl through his raven eyes. When Fischl performs a Normal Attack against an opponent, Oz fires a coordinated attack, dealing DMG equal to 22% of Fischl's ATK.

constellations.name: Devourer of All Sins
constellations.description: When Nightrider is used, it deals an additional 200% ATK as DMG, and its AoE is increased by 50%.

constellations.name: Wings of Nightmare
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Nightrider by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Her Pilgrimage of Bleak
constellations.description:
When Midnight Phantasmagoria is used, it deals 222% of ATK as Electro DMG to surrounding opponents.
When the skill duration ends, Fischl regenerates 20% of her HP.

constellations.name: Against the Fleeing Light
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Midnight Phantasmagoria by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Evernight Raven
constellations.description: Extends the duration of Oz's presence on the field by 2s. Additionally, Oz performs coordinated attacks with your active character when present, dealing 30% of Fischl's ATK as Electro DMG.

outfits.name: Ein Immernachtstraum
outfits.description: A ceremonial outfit for the Prinzessin. May she who is noble retain her courage, sincerity, and kindness forever, such that no evil shall ever overcome her.

outfits.name: Dunkelnacht Sakrament
outfits.description: Fischl's outfit. The Prinzessin der Verurteilung's customary vestments during her sojourn upon this realm.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> I, Fischl, Prinzessin der Verurteilung, descend upon this land by the call of fate an— Oh, you are also a traveler from another world? Very well, I grant you permission to travel with me.\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> She means, "Nice to meet you."

voices.title: Chat: Whispers of Destiny
voices.text: I hear the voice of fate, speaking my name in humble supplication...

voices.title: Chat: Creation of the World
voices.text: Hm-hm, may the glory of the Prinzessin bring light to this world.

voices.title: Chat: One From the Beyond
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> I do worry about the well-being of my retinue during my impromptu absence...\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> I'm sure the good people of the Adventurers' Guild are absolutely fine, mein Fräulein.

voices.title: After the Rain
voices.text: Oh, the sun's out— Oh, um... This meteorological transformation is most splendid! Like a felicitous twist of fate in the face of certain doom.

voices.title: When Thunder Strikes
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Hark! 'Tis Thundering Retribution, an omen of dark times ahead...\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> That, and mein Fräulein's laundry is still on the line...\n<color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Wha... Seriously!?

voices.title: When It Snows
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> A wonderful sight indeed. Why, it reminds me of my home world, where at the sight of the Prinzessin der Verurteilung, the very blood and tears of sinners turn to ice! ...Achoo! Achoo!\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> Not only their blood and tears, but also their saliva and mucus, mein Fräulein.\n<color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Oz— Ahh—Achoo!!!

voices.title: When the Sun Is Out
voices.text:
<color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Ozzie, my dear familiar...
<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> "Ozzie?" What's gotten into you...
<color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Her Majesty beseeches you to unfurl your blessèd wings, and with them blot out the heavens, plunging the world into eternal night...
<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> If you didn't bring your parasol with you, that's your own fault, mein Fräulein!

voices.title: Good Morning: Greet Fischl
voices.text: Dusk and dawn but fleeting shadows are. Once more, the twists of fate have led you into my everlasting night.

voices.title: Good Morning: Greet Oz
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> Good morning. Mein Fräulein heard you'd be dropping by, so she's preparing breakfast.\n<color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Oz! ...Ahem. To what do I owe the pleasure?

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Even one of royal blood finds oneself susceptible to drowsiness at this hour.

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> The stars of firmament are naught but rifts, thrust open by Oz's beak into the boundless tapestry of darkness.\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> You do say the strangest things, mein Fräulein.

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Sweet shall be thy sleep, spared of the Mares of the Night! For no Night-Mares would dare draw near to those who are blessed by the Immernachtreich!\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> She means, "Goodnight."

voices.title: About Fischl: Prinzessin der Verurteilung
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Me? Hehehe. Remember thou this, that I, Fischl, am the Prinzessin der Verurteilung, Sovereign of Immernachtreich, omniscient and eminent judge of all the world's iniquity!\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> She's an investigator for the Adventurers' Guild.\n<color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> ...Ahem. That is but one of my many royal engagements.

voices.title: About Us: Beings Who Descended Upon This World
voices.text: Huh, you and I are both travelers from another world. That our paths have crossed here is no accident, but the will of fate.

voices.title: About Us: Shooting Down the World Beast
voices.text: You seem... troubled. Traveler, do not lose heart! For with my left eye, the Auge der Verurteilung, which sees the threads of fate, I will surely keep you from harm. And Oz, the raven that has witnessed the demise of countless worlds, will watch over you on your journey. Should this world, like a beast prowling in the night, covet your dreams, then I, Prinzessin der Verurteilung, shall fell it with my ensorcelled arrows of judgment!

voices.title: About Us: Ones Dear to Heart
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Oz, my loyal companion. That we should have met this person, one who hails from another world as I do... Perhaps even cruel fate has deigned to smile upon me, though sin courses through my veins. If I am indeed destined to remain here, in this inescapable prison that is reality, at least—\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> I understand, mein Fräulein! In this traveler, Fräulein has found one who will never forsake her.

voices.title: About Us: Standing Watch
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Ozvaldo von Hrafnavins. I, the Prinzessin der Verurteilung, sovereign of the Immernachtreich, do hereby call upon thee to do all within thy power to deliver the traveler from the claws of fate that would seek to snatch them at every turn, and to ready thy mind lest thou be required to make the ultimate sacrifice in the performance of this noblest of duties.\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> ...You'd place my life in danger so easily, mein Fräulein?

voices.title: About the Vision
voices.text: Oh? You inquire about my Edelstein der Dunkelheit? It is a royal heirloom, a ceremonial ornament that displays the majesty of the Prinzessin der Verurteilung before the unworthy. Even here, in this fallen world, I have been reunited with my rightful inheritance as one of royal blood and noble spirit, for the majesty of a true princess shall draw her royal heirlooms unto her wherever so she may roam.

voices.title: Something to Share
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> If one must reckon time as this world does, I, Fischl, have already seen three thousand winters. Not that the illusory passage of time has any bearing on one such as I, to whom the causality of three thousand universes has been unveiled.\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> Be that as it may, mein Fräulein, you are not yet considered to be of drinking age in this world, and no bartender can ever be convinced otherwise.

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: Oz's full name is Ozvaldo von Hrafnavins. Where I hail from, he holds dominion over star and sky across three universes, and the souls of the mighty, fallen in battle, rest in the shadow of his wings. One should add that the penalty for mispronouncing his name is to have one's tongue torn from one's mouth. However, as I am a princess and you are one who has my favor, we are at liberty to simply call him, "Oz."

voices.title: About Bennett
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Ah, the ill-starred young man... My Auge der Verurteilung has seen with unmistakable clarity how his heart ails at being forsaken by the world—\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> Someone needs to keep an eye on the unlucky fellow.

voices.title: About Lisa
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> The magus-custodian of books, gatekeeper of universal knowledge... Win her trust, and one may yet gain access to a vast repository of wisdom...\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> She means as long as you return your first few library books on time, you'll never have any trouble borrowing a book again.

voices.title: About Kaeya
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> His nature is obscure, his fate a mystery, and his speech a vexing tapestry woven of both fact and fiction... Perhaps he and I share the burden of mystical sight...\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> Or perhaps he's secretly an actual pirate?

voices.title: About Mona
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Aha, yes, Mona, the mighty astrologer... Mona, who once had the vanity to probe the fate of the Prinzessin der Verurteilung herself! She wound up a trembling wreck, overborne and overmastered.\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> The poor lass was trying desperately not to laugh. It was no easy task.

voices.title: About Rosaria
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> One finds Sister Rosaria to be a most devout believer in the Anemo Archon.\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> ..."Devout believer," mein Fräulein?\n<color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Indeed! One night, I heard her invoking the name of the Archon thus in another's presence: "May you be struck down in the name of Lord Bartabos!" One presumed that she was leading a prayer.

voices.title: About Fischl: I
voices.text: To condemn the guilty, to sanctify the just, and to draw all castaway dreams into the embrace of the infinite Immernachtreich. This is the birthright of the Prinzessin der Verurteilung, and her burden. None may gainsay it.

voices.title: About Fischl: II
voices.text: My left eye? It is the all-seeing Auge der Verurteilung, which reveals all that is true in the world. As to the question of why I conceal it... Well, would you willingly bear the agony of piercing to the heart of all truths? Furthermore... the world would lose much of its appeal if wholly stripped of delusion and falsehood.

voices.title: About Fischl: III
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Stormterror? Why, one never would have thought that a being that one might have kept as her pet could, in this world, be capable of causing such calamity. *sigh* Pitiable are the incompetents of this world...\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> That said, mein Fräulein, were you not beside yourself with worry for everyone's safety during said calamity?\n<color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Th—That is because the Prinzessin der Verurteilung has the solemn duty to safeguard the souls of all, be they petty beings or not...

voices.title: About Fischl: IV
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> Some people address her by other names. But to me, the one who gave me life and bestowed my powers upon me is Fischl, and none other. All things considered, Fischl is the name that most aptly captures her identity. Seriously, don't call her anything else, or—\n<color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Oh, how one's royal ears do burn! Pray tell, what is the matter which you discuss so furtively?\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> Mid—Midnight Phantasmagoria, mein Fräulein! And... the majesty of the Verurteilung name!

voices.title: About Fischl: V
voices.text: Why must the Prinzessin der Verurteilung punish sin? Because sin defies fate's rightful decree, of course! ...And of course, fate brought you here, so, so... Ahem! It was fate that saw to your descent upon this world, destiny that saw our paths intertwined. I, Fischl, shall always protect you. Because... because fate has revealed to me that this is what has been decreed!

voices.title: Fischl's Hobbies: Ask Fischl
voices.text: I, Fischl, have roamed the galaxy and traversed countless worlds. I have learned the fate of ten thousand universes and have had revealed unto me the destiny of every living soul.

voices.title: Fischl's Hobbies: Ask Oz
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> Mein Fräulein reads a lot of novels. *sigh* My name, "Oz," is from one of her favorites.

voices.title: Fischl's Troubles
voices.text: What does it take to rile a princess? ...If you must know, it is those who cannot recognize my true identity. But it is no great loss, for solitude is the noble's lot, so long as I do not lose the nobility of my soul...

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Hmph! What is food but the shackles of mortal flesh? ...But if the Prinzessin der Verurteilung should reckon any morsel worthy, then it must be the tears of sinners and the tongues of liars.\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> Has mein Fräulein lost her appetite for the Mitternachtsbrot des Sommernachtgartens?\n<color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> ...Uh— That is merely to provide mine earthly vessel with such sustenance as it doth require to perform its royal duties!

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text:
<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> I believe I know the answer to this one...
<color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Indeed you do, Oz! Ah, that poor mortal coil, mutilated by bondage unnatural...
<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> It will never again fly as I do...
<color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Deprived of the humble coif with which it was born to gaze in awe at the majesty of its monarch... Surely it is a glimpse of my homeworld's hell, in the flesh. Hmm, the name of the dish escapes me...
<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> Something something "Madame," isn't it?

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Such an exquisite delicacy is worthy of being served in the Garten Sanssouci.\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> Mein Fräulein says that she thoroughly enjoys your delicious cooking.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> To vanquish the Beast of the World, one must first rise above mundane desires, thus weaving the path that leads to destiny.\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> And yet, on this occasion, you appear to have eaten your fill, mein Fräulein.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Why dost thou insist on raining down chaos and destruction in the presence of your Prinzessin?\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> Mein Fräulein does not care a great deal for this dish. My apologies.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Well! If today is truly the anniversary of your birth, it shan't do for me not to mark the occasion. You have my full attention. Speak! Speak to me of your wishes, that which you most desire to fulfill during your fleeting and harsh existence in this wretched world. Whatever that wish may be. Even if, perchance—\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> She means, "Happy Birthday, and if you want, she can—"\n<color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> Silence, Oz.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> My magic arrow cries out my holy name as it streaks through the night, praying that the violet lightning of retribution shall strike the enemies of fate down from the skies!\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> Quite awe-inspiring, mein Fräulein! Since it's nearly dinner time, perhaps you might shoot a pigeon down while you're at it?

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: <color=#37FFFF>Fischl:</color> With this, I may more fully manifest my majesty as Prinzessin der Verurteilung, and defeat that sworn enemy of fate named "reality."\n<color=#37FFFF>Oz:</color> It will also be of use in your work for the Adventurers' Guild, mein Fräulein.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: Rejoice! Else, tremble in fear! Whenceforth springs this call to mirth and misery, you ask? Let it be known that I, the Prinzessin der Verurteilung, sovereign of the Immernachtreich, have peered forth with mine leftmost eye into the tapestry of fate that doth make up the universe, and beheld its every warp, weft and dangling orphaned thread!

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: I appear to have now regained most of the strength I lost in my transition to this world. Mwuhahaha, the day of judgment is nigh! ...Ah, worry not. Even at the last, when I bring the lightning of retribution upon this world, you shall come to no harm, for thou art blessed by the Prinzessin.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: By royal decree!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: Oz, reveal thyself!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: I summon thee!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: IV
voices.text: Oz: No rest for the wicked...

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Wings of Darkness, come, sever night from day!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: Midnight Phantasmagoria!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: III
voices.text: Shadow raven, let night fall!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: IV
voices.text: Oz: As you wish, mein Fräulein!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: V
voices.text: Oz: Midnight Phantasmagoria!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: Destiny has brought me hither!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: What trinkets lie veiled within this desolate plane?

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: Hahaha, cry out my illustrious name!

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: Doth thou wish to witness my true power?

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: Oz: Mein Fräulein! Should you fall...

voices.title: Low HP: III
voices.text: This cruel fate befits not one of royal blood!

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: Hmph! Allow me!

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: Oz: Mein Fräulein, your presence is urgently required...

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: This realm is no home for a princess...

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: One shall... descend... once again...

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: Oz: Mein Fräulein!

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Insubordination!

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: In the name of the Prinzessin!

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: Oz: Behold, the Prinzessin der Verurteilung!

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: The threads of your fate lie in my hands!
